title: Stephen Miller Goes Off on Dr. Fauci After Explosive Senate Hearing (VIDEO) * The Gateway Pundit * by Cristina Laila
text:
Trump advisor Stephen Miller went off on Dr. Fauci during an appearance on Fox News on Wednesday evening.
Earlier Wednesday, Dr. Anthony Fauci, the former NIAID director and face of America’s disastrous COVID response, finally appeared under subpoena Wednesday morning before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee.
After enjoying his celebrity status and appearing on all of the networks during the Covid pandemic, all of a sudden Fauci doesn’t want to talk.
Dr. Fauci invoked the Fifth Amendment in his opening statement in front of the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee on his actions that led to the COVID pandemic and his many lies told to the American public.
Fauci pleaded the Fifth Amendment 111 times, prompting Senator Rand Paul to move to hold him in contempt of Congress.
Stephen Miller went off on Fauci after the explosive Senate hearing.
“Trump was the one who questioned the origins of COVID. President Trump is the one who questioned the need for requiring every single American to be tested over and over and over again!” Stephen Miller said.
“He’s the one who questioned whether we should require children and healthy adults to be subject to restrictions for an illness that primarily targets the elderly,” Miller said.
“He fought to reopen the government. And if you remember the Biden campaign in 2020 spent hundreds of millions of dollars demonizing president Trump for fighting to keep America safe to open,” Miller said.
“At every single step every day the news cycle was the so-called health care establishment attacking President Trump for questioning the experts,” he said.
WATCH:
Senator Rand Paul on Wednesday announced the Senate Homeland Security and Government Affairs Committee will hold a vote to hold Dr. Anthony Fauci in contempt for refusing to answer any questions during the hearing.
